role: upstream jax-fem default jax_solver (iterative on GPU)
linear_solver: jax_fem.solver.jax_solver: PETSc CSR -> JAX BCOO on device -> jax.scipy.sparse.linalg.bicgstab with Jacobi (diagonal) preconditioner, tol 1e-10, atol 1e-10, maxiter 10000; SciPy spsolve fallback ON (counted in profile meta solver_fallbacks)
notes: The pipeline the user sketched: GPU element level -> host CSR assembly -> GPU sparse iterative solve. Accuracy is expected to drift (iterative tolerance) and the mechanics matrix (non-symmetric, 1e-4/1e-2/1% stiffness contrasts) is where Jacobi-preconditioned Krylov is expected to struggle.
env_note: jax-fem-env lives under miniforge3; jax-fem-gpu was cloned under miniconda3 (output/gpu_env_setup.sh) -- `conda activate` from miniforge's conda.sh cannot see it, so arms are launched by absolute python path (the L0/D-11 PYTHON_BIN convention).
